search_notes: Alphabetical, unranked list. Verified 2026-10-02 UTC, corresponding to 2026-10-01 America/New_York. Every listed repository passed gh api repos/OWNER/REPO and repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest checks: public, not archived, and a release or default-branch commit within 90 days. README files and default-branch commits were also inspected through the GitHub API. Release dates are published_at values. License screening excluded MCP Agent Mail because its [license contains an OpenAI/Anthropic restriction](https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/mcp_agent_mail/blob/3fad5ec67286/LICENSE), Okto Nexus because its [Elastic License and addendum restrict use](https://github.com/OktoLabsAI/okto-nexus/blob/27b06fe48b9f/LICENSE), and amux because its [MIT-plus-Commons-Clause license restricts commercial resale](https://github.com/mixpeek/amux/blob/main/LICENSE). A2A requires client integration; Sno Reach currently requires working from source. The native baseline was assessed from upstream documentation; installed clients were not inspected under the upstream-only rule. Budget used: 5 web-search queries, 8 page-fetch attempts and 30 GitHub API calls. Additional discovery leads remained unverified at the API limit, so exhaustive coverage is not established.
